statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST always include the Seek-Style header in any PLAY response for media with random access properties to indicate what policy was applied.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server searched to a random access point (CoRAP condition fulfilled: RAP is closer to requested start point than to current pause point), the server MUST return the CoRAP policy in the Seek-Style header and adjust the Range header to reflect the position of the selected RAP.
statements.trigger: PLAY request with CoRAP seek style received, CoRAP condition fulfilled
statements.pre_cond: session.seek_style = CoRAP & distance(RAP, requested_start) < distance(RAP, current_pause_point)
statements.post_cond: response.Seek-Style = CoRAP & response.Range reflects RAP position
actions: set Seek-Style to CoRAP in PLAY response
adjust Range header to RAP position

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In case the random access point is farther away and the server chooses to continue from the current pause point, it MUST include the 'Next' policy in the Seek-Style header and adjust the Range header start point to the current pause point.
statements.trigger: PLAY request with CoRAP seek style received, CoRAP condition not fulfilled
statements.pre_cond: session.seek_style = CoRAP & distance(RAP, requested_start) >= distance(RAP, current_pause_point)
actions: set Seek-Style to Next in PLAY response
adjust Range start to current pause point

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server that receives an unknown Seek-Style policy MUST ignore it and select the server default policy.
statements.trigger: PLAY request with unknown Seek-Style policy received

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A client receiving an unknown [Seek-Style] policy MUST ignore it and use the Range header and any media synchronization information as basis to determine what the server did.
statements.trigger: PLAY response with unknown Seek-Style policy received
statements.post_cond: client uses Range header and media synchronization information to determine server action
actions: ignore unknown Seek-Style policy in response
use Range header and media synchronization to determine server action

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The 'Next' policy MUST only be used on the client's explicit request.
statements.guard_semantics: client has explicitly requested Next policy in PLAY request Seek-Style header
